decisions.reason: As a multi-model industrial line serving core customers and matching the firm's strategic push into robust, energy-efficient professional lighting, the prior investment and visible commitment strongly favor persistence.

The designer task light remains close to the established offer and its public relaunch of a previously popular model creates reputational commitment, so management is inclined to continue unless weakness becomes unmistakable.

The pendant office luminaire fits the firm's mainstream building-lighting business and LED-oriented direction, and in an expanding firm management can still explain any slower uptake as temporary rather than grounds for withdrawal.

The premium pendant luminaire is close to the core range and was introduced as a multi-model line, implying greater sunk development effort and public commitment that make continuation more likely than exit.
